```{r define filepath}
basedir <- here ()
```

```{r import excel}
# Import only lab data sheet from excel file
table_pathology <- readxl::read_xlsx(
  here("data", "RNAseq-CarTrans_Long_Clinical Data_ALL PATIENTS_Export.xlsx"),
  sheet = "Pathology",
  col_names = TRUE)
```

```{r clean table_lab}
#Previous labeling of EMB4 still gets imported, although it`s not visible in original excel
# Remove double EMB 4 entries
table_pathology <- table_pathology %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -`Date of EMB 4`,
    -`ISHLT 1990 EMB 4`,
    -`ISHLT 2004 EMB e`,
    -`pAMR EMB 34`,
    -`Entzündliche Infiltrate EMB4`,
    -`Histologie der entzündlichen Infiltrate EMB4`,
    -`Quilty-Läsion EMB4`,
    -`C4d EMB4`,
    -`CD68/CD31 EMB4`,
    -`Date of EMB5`)

#Clean all EMB6 or EMB7 and CarTrans-Long-009
table_pathology <- table_pathology %>%
filter(ID != "CarTrans-Long-009") %>%
select(-matches("EMB6|EMB7"))
```

# Overview pathological gradings for ISHLT 1990

```{r prep dataframe for 1990 grading}
#Prep table
df_1990 <- table_pathology %>%
  select(starts_with("ISHLT_1990"))

df_1990 <- df_1990 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "Timepoint",
    values_to = "Grade"
  )

#Relabel timepoints
df_1990 <- df_1990 %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = str_remove(Timepoint, "ISHLT_1990_"),
    Timepoint = recode(Timepoint,
      "EMB1" = "Week 1",
      "EMB2" = "Week 2",
      "EMB3" = "Month 1-3",
      "EMB4" = "Month 4-6",
      "EMB5" = "12 Months",
      "EMBX1" = "Rejection Context",
      "EMBX2" = "Rejection Context",
      "EMBX3" = "Rejection Context",
      "EMBX4" = "Rejection Context"
    )
  )

#Set order
df_1990$Timepoint <- factor(
  df_1990$Timepoint,
  levels = c(
    "Week 1",
    "Week 2",
    "Month 1-3",
      "Month 4-6",
    "12 Months",
    "Rejection Context"
  )
)

#Filter missing values
df_1990 <- df_1990 %>%
  filter(!is.na(Grade))

#Set colors for different gradings
grade_colors_1990 <- c(
  "0"  = "#1a9641",  
  "1a" = "#66bd63",
  "1b" = "#a6d96a",
  "2"  = "#ffffbf",
  "3a" = "#fdae61",
  "3b" = "#f46d43",
  "4" = "#d73027"
)

```

```{r build count plot}
ggplot(df_1990, aes(x = Timepoint, fill = Grade)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = grade_colors_1990) +
  labs(
    title = "ISHLT 1990 Grades Across Timepoints",
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r distribution 1990}
ggplot(df_1990, aes(x = Timepoint, fill = Grade)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = grade_colors_1990) +
  labs(
    title = "ISHLT 1990 Grade Distribution",
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Proportion"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

# Heatmap for pathological grading (ISHLT 2004)

```{r import datasets, include=FALSE}
# Import Luminex Data
  
  table_lum_healthy <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir, "data", "Lum_CarTrans_Healthy_all.xlsx"))  

  table_lum_CarTrans_V0<- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir, "data", "Lum_CarTrans_V0_all.xlsx")) 
   
  table_lum_CarTrans_V1<- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir, "data", "Lum_CarTrans_V1_all.xlsx")) 
  
  table_lum_CarTrans_V2 <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir, "data", "Lum_CarTrans_V2_all.xlsx"))
  
  table_lum_CarTrans_V3 <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir, "data", "Lum_CarTrans_V3_all.xlsx"))
  
  table_lum_CarTrans_V4 <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir,"data", "Lum_CarTrans_V4_all.xlsx"))
  
  table_lum_CarTrans_V5 <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir,"data", "Lum_CarTrans_V5_all.xlsx"))
  
table_lum_CarTrans_VX <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir,"data", "Lum_CarTrans_VX_all.xlsx"))

# Delete column Class_Sup and Transplantation risk
table_lum_healthy     <- table_lum_healthy     %>% select(-Class_Sup, - Transplantation_risk, -ATG_EMB1_3)
table_lum_CarTrans_V0 <- table_lum_CarTrans_V0 %>% select(-Class_Sup, - Transplantation_risk, -ATG_EMB1_3)
table_lum_CarTrans_V1 <- table_lum_CarTrans_V1 %>% select(-Class_Sup, - Transplantation_risk, -ATG_EMB1_3)
table_lum_CarTrans_V2 <- table_lum_CarTrans_V2 %>% select(-Class_Sup, - Transplantation_risk, -ATG_EMB1_3)
table_lum_CarTrans_V3 <- table_lum_CarTrans_V3 %>% select(-Class_Sup, - Transplantation_risk, -ATG_EMB1_3)
table_lum_CarTrans_V4 <- table_lum_CarTrans_V4 %>% select(-Class_Sup, - Transplantation_risk)
table_lum_CarTrans_V5 <- table_lum_CarTrans_V5 %>% select(-Class_Sup, - Transplantation_risk)

# Combine Tables
  table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- dplyr::bind_rows(table_lum_CarTrans_V0, table_lum_CarTrans_V1, table_lum_CarTrans_V2, table_lum_CarTrans_V3, table_lum_CarTrans_V4, table_lum_CarTrans_V5, table_lum_CarTrans_VX, table_lum_healthy)   %>%
    mutate(across(-c(Study_ID, Visit, ISHLT_1990, ISHLT_2004), ~{
        x <- as.numeric(as.character(.))  
      })) %>%     
    filter(!Study_ID %in% c("CarTrans-Long-38", "CarTrans-Long-39", "CarTrans-Long-40", "CarTrans-Long-41", "CarTrans-Long-42", "CarTrans-Long-43", "CarTrans-Long-44", "CarTrans-Long-45", "CarTrans-Long-46", "CarTrans-Long-47", "CarTrans-Long-48", "CarTrans-Long-49", "CarTrans-Long-50", "CarTrans-Long-51", "CarTrans-Healthy-29", "CarTrans-Healthy-30", "CarTrans-Healthy-31", "CarTrans-Healthy-32", "CarTrans-Healthy-33", "CarTrans-Healthy-34", "CarTrans-Healthy-35", "CarTrans-Healthy-36", "CarTrans-Healthy-37", "CarTrans-Healthy-38", "CarTrans-Healthy-39", "CarTrans-Healthy-40", "CarTrans-Healthy-41", "CarTrans-Healthy-42", "CarTrans-Healthy-43", "CarTrans-Healthy-44", "CarTrans-Healthy-45", "CarTrans-Healthy-46", "CarTrans-Healthy-47", "CarTrans-Healthy-48","CarTrans-Healthy-49", "CarTrans-Healthy-50")) #Exclude unmeasured samples
  

```

```{r clean overall table and prep for heatmap}

#Create unique Study_ID by combination with Visit
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  mutate(Study_ID = paste(Study_ID, Visit, sep = "_"))

```

# Create Heatmap for ISHLT 2004 grading

```{r r heatmap 2004 overall, fig.height=10, fig.width=13}
# Exclude CT-Long-010/5 from further analysis (no pathological grading)
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  filter(Study_ID != "CarTrans-Long-10_V5")

# Create annotation table
list_pathology2004 <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%dplyr::select(Study_ID, ISHLT_2004)

rownames(list_pathology2004) <- list_pathology2004$Study_ID
list_pathology2004  <- list_pathology2004 [, c("ISHLT_2004"), drop = FALSE]  

# Remove metadata columns
table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01 <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  dplyr::select(-Study_ID, -Visit)

# Convert Data Table to Data Frame
  table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01 <- as.data.frame(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01)
  
# Select preserved cytokines
#  table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01 <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01 %>%
#                              dplyr::select(HGF, IL2R, CXCL9, CXCL10, CXCL8, IL6, CCL3, CCL4)

# Transpose Data Table
  table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t <- t(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01)
  
## Column Annotations
  colnames(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t) <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall$Study_ID


## Row Annotations
  # Create list with Parameters 
    list_parameter_groups <- read.xlsx(file.path(basedir,"data", "Grouping of Luminex Marker.xlsx"))

  # Create list with Columns of data table
    list_parameter_datatable <- as.data.frame(rownames(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t))
                                colnames(list_parameter_datatable) <- "Parameter"

  # Merge to match the order of parameters
    list_parameter_groups_01 <- merge(list_parameter_groups, list_parameter_datatable, by.y = "Parameter")

# Define the predefined order for Group
  group_order <- c("Cytokine", "Chemokine", "Growth factor/Tissue Cytokine", "Activation Marker")

# Order list based on predefined order
#  selected_markers <- c("HGF","IL2R", "CXCL9", "CXCL10", "IL6", "CCL3", "CCL4")
  
# Filter and order
  list_parameter_groups_02 <- list_parameter_groups_01 %>%
#                              filter(Parameter %in% selected_markers) %>%
                              mutate(Grouping = factor(Grouping, levels = group_order)) %>%
#                              Parameter = factor(Parameter, levels = selected_markers)) %>%
                              arrange(Parameter)
  
# Extract ordered parameter vector
  list_parameter_groups_03 <- as.character(list_parameter_groups_02$Parameter)

# Reorder Data Table based on the new ordered list
  table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered <- as.data.frame(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t)
  table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t[list_parameter_groups_03, ]

# Convert it back to matrix
  table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered <- as.matrix(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered)

#Convert back to numeric
  table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered <- matrix(
    as.numeric(trimws(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered)),
    nrow = nrow(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered),
    dimnames = dimnames(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered))
  
# Log Transform 
  table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered <- log2(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered)
  
# Scale 
  table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered <- t(apply(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered, 1, scale))

  
# Create Cohort Label Colors of Annotations in heatmap
  ann_colors <- list(
  ISHLT_2004 = c(
   "Healthy" = "grey",
  "Baseline" = "#E0F7FA", 
  "ACR 0"  = "#1a9850",   
  "ACR 1R" = "#fcae91",  
  "ACR 2R" = "#fb6a4a",   
  "ACR 3R" = "#cb181d"
),
  Grouping = c(
    "Cytokine" = "darkseagreen",
    "Chemokine" = "lightblue", 
    "Growth factor/Tissue Cytokine" = "mediumpurple3",
    "Activation Marker" =  "lightpink"))

# Column Annotation
  col_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(df = list_pathology2004, col = ann_colors)

# Row Annotation
  #  Prepare row annotations as a data frame
  row_anno <- rowAnnotation(Grouping = list_parameter_groups_02$Grouping,
                            col = list(Grouping = ann_colors$Grouping))

# Create Heatmap
  heatmap_lum <- Heatmap(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered, 
                         name = "Expression",  
                         col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(-5, 0, 5), c("blue", "white", "red")),  
                         cluster_rows = TRUE,  
                         cluster_columns = TRUE,  
                         clustering_method_columns = "ward.D",  
                         show_column_names = TRUE,  
                         column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),  
                         row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),  
                         width = unit(18, "cm"), height = unit(15, "cm"),  
                         top_annotation = col_anno,
                         right_annotation = row_anno)

# Draw Heatmap
  show(heatmap_lum)
  
```
```{r heatmap 2004 split, fig.height=9, fig.width=16}
# Reorder grouped visits
list_pathology2004$ISHLT_2004 <- factor(list_pathology2004$ISHLT_2004,levels = c("Healthy", "Baseline", "ACR 0","ACR 1R","ACR 2R","ACR 3R"))


# Create Heatmap split by visits
  heatmap_lum_split <- Heatmap(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_01_t_ordered, 
                         name = "Expression",  
                         col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(-5, 0, 5), c("blue", "white", "red")),  
                         cluster_rows = TRUE,  
                         cluster_columns = FALSE,
                         clustering_method_columns = "ward.D",  
                         show_column_names = TRUE,  
                         column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
                         column_names_centered = TRUE, #without rotation ACR 3R overlaps
                         row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),  
                         width = unit(23, "cm"), height = unit(15, "cm"),  
                         top_annotation = col_anno,
                         right_annotation = row_anno,
                         column_split = list_pathology2004$ISHLT_2004,
                         column_gap = unit(5, "mm") 
                          )


# Draw Heatmap
  show(heatmap_lum_split)
```

# Volcano plot for pathological grading

```{r volcano plot of rejection vs CarTrans overall}
# Exclude Healthy Condition from the comparison
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%filter(Visit != c("Healthy", "Baseline"))

# Rename Healthy vs all CarTrans Visits
  table_lum_CarTrans_overall$ISHLT_2004 <- ifelse(table_lum_CarTrans_overall$ISHLT_2004 %in% c("ACR 0", "ACR 1R"), "NoRejection", "Rejection")

# Calculate p-values between Rejection and No Rejection
    
  # Create the loop.vector (all the parameter columns)
    names(which(sapply(table_lum_CarTrans_overall, is.numeric) == TRUE)) -> parameters 

  # Create table for stats
    table_lum_CarTrans_overall_stat <- data.table (Parameter = numeric(), group1 = character(), 
                                              group2 = character(), n1 = numeric(),
                                              n2 = numeric(), statistic = numeric (),
                                              p = numeric (), p.signif = character(), FDR = numeric()) #FDR False Discovery Rate
   
  # Create loop for calculation of stat test by parameter between Rejection and No Rejection
    for (i in parameters)
      
    { 
      # Formula to insert parameter in loop 
        formula = as.formula( paste(i, "ISHLT_2004", sep="~") )
          
        stat_parameter <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>% 
                          wilcox_test(formula = formula) %>%
                          add_significance() %>%
                          mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>% #Benjamini-Hochberg correction
                          rename(Parameter = .y.)
        
      # Combine currently calculated stats with previous calculations
        table_lum_CarTrans_overall_stat <- rbind(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_stat, stat_parameter)
    }

# Calculate FC between different Visits
    
      # Calculate Mean of parameters per group
        table_lum_CarTrans_overall_log2  <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>% 
                                       group_by(ISHLT_2004) %>%
                                       summarise(across(CCL11:BMP4, ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))
      
      # Transverse Data Table and set rownames
        table_lum_CarTrans_overall_log2_t  <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall_log2  %>% 
                                         t %>% 
                                         as.data.frame() %>% 
                                         row_to_names(1)
     
     # Convert whole data table to numeric
       table_lum_CarTrans_overall_log2_t  <- mutate_all(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_log2_t, 
                                                   function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))
       
     # Calculate FC between Rejection and CarTrans Overall
       table_lum_CarTrans_overall_log2_t$log2_fc <- log2(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_log2_t$Rejection /
                                                    table_lum_CarTrans_overall_log2_t$NoRejection)
       
     # Add p-values to data table
        # Extract only Parameters and p-values
           stat.test_p <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall_stat %>% 
                          dplyr::select(Parameter, FDR)

        # Merge data tables (log2, FC, p val)
          table_lum_CarTrans_overall_log2_t$Parameter <- rownames(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_log2_t)
          table_lum_CarTrans_overall_volcano <- merge(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_log2_t, stat.test_p, by = "Parameter")
 
  # Create Volcano Plot
          
     # Mark parameters if FC > 1.5 = upregulated
       table_lum_CarTrans_overall_volcano$diff_expression <- ifelse (table_lum_CarTrans_overall_volcano$log2_fc > 1.5, 
                                                                "up", "no")
     
     # Add new column to relabel parameters FC of > 1.5
      table_lum_CarTrans_overall_volcano$label_para <- ifelse (table_lum_CarTrans_overall_volcano$log2_fc > 1.5, 
                                                          table_lum_CarTrans_overall_volcano$Parameter, "")    
    
      plot_volcano <- EnhancedVolcano(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_volcano, 
                                      lab = table_lum_CarTrans_overall_volcano$label_para,
                                      x = 'log2_fc', y = 'FDR', 
                                      FCcutoff = 1.5, pointSize = 3.5, labSize = 4, colAlpha = 0.7, 
                                      boxedLabels = TRUE, col = c("grey", "grey", "grey", "darkred"),   
                                      xlab = bquote(~Log[2]~ "fold change"), ylab = bquote("FDR-adjusted p-value"),
                                      xlim = c(0, 3.5), ylim = c(0, 40), pCutoff = 0.05,
                                      title = NULL, subtitle = NULL, border = 'full',
                                      drawConnectors = TRUE,widthConnectors = 0.5, colConnectors = "darkred") +
                                      theme_classic() +
                                      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
                                            panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA,),
                                            legend.position = "none")
      
      print( plot_volcano)
```
